description: This file implements the 'Play' task for a web audio player, including constructor, destructor, and execution logic to change the pipeline state to playing, with logging and error handling.

classes.name: Play
classes.description: Represents a task to start playing web audio by changing the pipeline state to playing.

methods.name: Play::Play
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Play task with a web audio player and client.

methods.name: Play::~Play
methods.description: Destructor for the Play task, logs when the task is finished.

methods.name: Play::execute
methods.description: Executes the task to change the web audio pipeline state to playing, with logging and error handling.
